description: This file defines a SyncManager class responsible for synchronizing local database data with remote storage or other data sources. It manages the last sync timestamp, retrieves modified data entries, and handles synchronization flow with status reporting.

classes.name: SyncManager
classes.description: Manages data synchronization between local database and remote storage, including handling last sync timestamps and emitting sync status flow.

classes.name: SyncStatus
classes.description: Represents the current status of synchronization, with possible states: Started, Success, Error.

methods.name: sync
methods.description: Initiates the synchronization process, emitting sync status updates, attempting to sync data modified after the last sync time.

methods.name: getLastSyncTime
methods.description: Retrieves the timestamp of the last successful sync from shared preferences.

methods.name: saveLastSyncTime
methods.description: Saves the current sync timestamp into shared preferences to record the latest sync time.
